name: Steigenberger Wiltcher’s
insider_take: A legendary Brussels institution where European aristocracy and international dignitaries have gathered for over a century in the heart of the capital's most prestigious district.
whats_special: This historic hotel sits directly across from Brussels Central Station and just steps from the iconic Grand Place, one of Europe's most beautiful medieval squares. The property has hosted royalty and world leaders since 1913, maintaining its reputation as Brussels' most distinguished address with its classic European elegance and impeccable service standards.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the bustling Boulevard de Waterloo for prime people-watching, or request a quiet courtyard view for ultimate tranquility while staying perfectly connected to the city's main attractions.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you within a 5-minute walk of the UNESCO World Heritage Grand Place, the famous Manneken Pis statue, and the Royal Galleries of Saint Hubert - Europe's first shopping arcade. The nearby Sablon district offers world-class antique shopping and Belgium's finest chocolate boutiques.
pros: Prime location near Brussels Central Station and Grand Place
Historic luxury hotel with classic European elegance
cons: Traditional formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
